blocks.text: An IP location refers to the geographical location associated with an IP address. These IP locations can be used to define and apply various sign-on policies.
IP locations provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Categorize multiple traffic egress points within your organization that access the Authentication Service.
Manage sign-on policies for users based on their locations.

blocks.text: On the Locations page (Administration > Authentication > Trusted IP Locations), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Import new IP locations, or modify existing IP locations, using a CSV file.
Select the columns to display in the table and click Apply.
Bulk delete IP locations. This Delete option is visible only when you select more than one location.
View a list of configured IP locations. For each IP location, you can see:
Country: The country in which this IP location exists.
IP Address: The IP address of the location.
Source: The source from where the IP location is added.
Select IP locations to perform bulk operations on them. You must select more than one IP location to view the Delete option.
